summary: Orion S.A. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to announce a press release declaring an interim dividend of $0.0207 per common share, payable July 2, 2026, to holders of record June 10, 2026, totaling ~$1.2 million. The filing is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation characteristics (no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or governance change). It is a standard quarterly dividend, not a capital return event or any other special situation. As a routine current report concerning an ordinary dividend, this is classified as 'None'.
